text:
anya: quick async OKR check — can we get short statuses for the three Q3 milestones: Autoscale (A), Private deploy (B), Integration tests (C). Reply with shipped/slipped/blocked + owner + ETA. thanks :pray:

mike: Autoscale (A): canary deployed last week, throughput tests green. rolling to prod tomorrow morning. Owner: @mike. ETA: 2025-03-07 (prod finish). No blockers.

sam: Private deploy (B): slipped. We hit issues with the on-prem installer and KMS integration during smoke tests. Owner: @sam. New ETA: 2025-03-21. Blocker: security review + infra creds (cc @lee).

lee: I picked up the infra creds work. Need a token-rotation/maintenance window to stitch KMS keys. Can we schedule a 2-hour window next Tue? KMS team also needs the list of endpoints we call.

anya: Scheduling note — @jordan can you coordinate the maintenance window with support/customers? We should avoid 9–11 PT.

jordan: I'll reach out to the top 6 Dedicated customers and support. Tentative slot Tue 03-11 01:00-03:00 PT. Will confirm by EOD.

mike: Integration tests (C): partial shipped. E2E failing on long-tail latency test — traces point to KV cache misses. Owner: @mike + eng-runtime. ETA: fix + redeploy by 2025-03-10. Short-term mitigation: bump per-request timeouts and enable cache warmup flag.

anya: Risk callout — if E2E isn't green by 03-10 we can't guarantee the Dedicated SLA next quarter. Prioritize cache fix over low-risk features.

sam: Agreed. Re-prioritizing: moving Priya and Carlos from Feature X to help on cache warmup.

mike: :thumbsup: That helps. Quick ask: need CR review on cache-warmup PR #472 — pinging @anya for product sign-off on the behavioral change.

anya: I'll review tonight. If I can't get to it, consider it approved for canary behind a feature flag.

release-bot: Deploy scheduled: autoscale -> prod at 2025-03-07 04:00 UTC. Change-ID: D-2219. CI: all green.

lee: Ops note: I updated alerts/dashboards for the autoscale metric thresholds and pushed a small runbook tweak (link in ops-docs).

sam: Quick question — do we count the autoscale rollout as "shipped" for the OKR or only after 48h stable metrics? Product wants clarity.

anya: For the OKR: mark as "shipped-to-prod" once rollout completes and metric stability is confirmed for 48h. For today's checkpoint, call it "partial shipped".

mike: Got it. I'll post a 48h follow-up thread after the rollout completes with final status.

anya: Action items recap: @mike — follow up with 48h stability report + CR ping #472; @sam — drive installer/KMS fixes and update ETA; @jordan — confirm maintenance window; @lee — confirm dashboard/runbook link in this thread; all — flag any additional blockers early. Thanks everyone.
